# Preface {-}

Welcome to the PS2010 Psychological Research Methods and Analysis Codebook

## About this Site

This was developed to accompany the PS2010 Psychological Research Methods and Analysis module at the Department of Psychology, Royal Holloway University of London.

This site is a work in progress and it is being continually updated and improved.

If you spot an error or something that doesn’t look quite right, please get in touch:

[luke.kendrick\@rhul.ac.uk](mailto:luke.kendrick@rhul.ac.uk){.email}.
